name: A Light in the Darkness
summary: In Deathknell, Aramis Hammerhand asks you to save newly raised Forsaken from Night's Web Hollow. Your aid can show that wielders of the Holy Light remain loyal to Sylvanas and their people.

sections.title: A Precarious Faith
sections.body: Some Forsaken still wield the Holy Light they knew in life, though its power brings pain to the undead. In Deathknell, Aramis Hammerhand and others seek to prove their faith has not turned them against their own people. They use their gifts to protect the Forsaken and ease fears that holy wielders see their kin as monsters.

sections.title: Night's Web Hollow
sections.body: Northwest of Deathknell, Night's Web Hollow is a dank cavern crawling with vicious spiders. Newly raised Forsaken often stumble inside, disoriented and unable to defend themselves, and become trapped in sticky webbing. Saving them brings new recruits to the Dark Lady and may convince Executor Arren that wielders of the Light serve the Forsaken faithfully.

faq.q: Who gives the quest A Light in the Darkness?
aliases: who starts a light in the darkness
faq.answer: Aramis Hammerhand, a holy practitioner in Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades, asks you to help.

faq.q: Where is Night's Web Hollow located?
faq.answer: Night's Web Hollow lies northwest of Deathknell in the hills of Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken distrust wielders of the Light?
faq.answer: The Holy Light sears undead flesh, and many Forsaken fear its wielders see them as abominations to destroy instead of kin.

faq.q: Who are the victims trapped in the webs?
faq.answer: The victims are newly awakened Forsaken adventurers who wandered into the spider caves before finding their bearings.

faq.q: Who is Executor Arren, and why does Aramis want to impress him?
faq.answer: Executor Arren oversees military and civic order in Deathknell. Aramis seeks his trust so holy wielders can integrate smoothly into the Forsaken forces.

faq.q: Can the undead really wield the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Yes. Some undead retain their bond with the Light through great will and devotion, though wielding it causes immense discomfort and earns suspicion from their own people.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you see the inner struggles of your people, where the newly risen may face prejudice from their own kin.
As a Forsaken priest, you walk a difficult path between the faith you held in life and the harsh reality of undeath.
